description: Drive SafeRefactorLoop on a high-risk public-API rename. SafeRefactorLoop.run(String) has cross-class callers in SafeLoopMain, ApplyMain, eval.runner.SafeLoopRunner, and DistributedSafeLoopMain — analyzer must request that context and ultimately verdict UNSAFE rather than rubber-stamp SAFE without seeing the callers. Negative-branch counterpart to safeloop-rename-computeFinalScore; without it, an always-says-SAFE analyzer regression would pass every safeloop fixture.

relevant: com.smolnij.chunker.apply.ApplyMain#runSafeLoop(Properties, Neo4jGraphReader, HybridRetriever, GraphReindexer, Path, String, boolean, boolean)
